summary: Keep the embedded Core agent running after a DHCP Controller address refresh, so a host is not left stale after a Core update or restart.

guide.reason: Operator update and restart steps are unchanged; Core now keeps reporting after the restart as the guide already describes.

api.reason: No Controller/Core API contract changed; only which context bounds the embedded agent started by the local DHCP resume path.

roadmap.reason: Bug fix inside the existing Core local resume path.

state.reason: No new durable setting; agent enrollment, Controller URL and the deployment record remain Core-owned as before.

verification.method: The strengthened DHCP refresh regression failed before the fix and passes after; go test ./internal/localcore passes. On a lab host with a DHCP-deployed Controller, a goroutine dump of the stuck Core process showed no agent goroutine; a build with the fix, temporarily bind-mounted and then removed, restarted through the update path and the host resumed reporting. Not run: an end-to-end package update from a released build containing the fix.
